feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 June 2026 8:44am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 01 June 2026 at 8:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex areas of low pressure to the west of the British Isles as various frontal zones affect the area.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at times this morning, decreasing 2 to 4 later this evening, becoming variable in places overnight. Veering west or southwest tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle with mist and fog patches, the mist and fog patches clearing early tonight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor and falling very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly west or southwest 2 to 4, but variable in places at first, increasing 4 or 5 overnight into Wednesday. Backing south or southeast 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain at first soon clearing to showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
